verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an incident-management SaaS with an API, MCP server and workflows, so the axis applies. The pack never documents a sandbox org, test environment, or test-mode API keys. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: previewing AI retrospective templates against a past incident (a dry-run-style preview, not sandbox isolation) and read-only AWS connector access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
